L&T Secures Large ONGC Contract for Offshore Project

Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has been awarded a significant contract by the Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) for an offshore project. The order value is estimated to be between ₹2,500 crore and ₹5,000 crore. The project involves the addition of four platforms and subsea pipelines. This development pertains to oil and gas development.
